edges.reason: Constructor reads msg.sender to initialize privileged state.
TWST constructor assigns admin from the deployer address.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to 1000000 * 10**18.
Constructor credits _balances[admin] with the whole supply.
_msgSender returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
transfer uses _msgSender as the sender address.
approve uses _msgSender as the owner address.
transferFrom uses _msgSender as the spender for allowance checks.
Any msg.sender can invoke the unrestricted public mint function.
mint exposes an unguarded token-creation operation to all callers.
mint credits the recipient balance in _balances.
mint increases the _totalSupply value.
mint uses SafeMath.add for supply and balance increases.
transfer delegates the balance move to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the balance move to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates allowance update to _approve.
approve delegates allowance storage to _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates allowance update to _approve.
decreaseAllowance delegates allowance update to _approve.
_transfer reads and writes both sides of the _balances mapping.
_transfer uses SafeMath.sub to debit the sender balance safely.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
increaseAllowance uses SafeMath.add for the new allowance.
decreaseAllowance uses SafeMath.sub for the new allowance.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub on the allowance value.
transferFrom reads the _allowances mapping for sender/spender.
safeTransfer encodes selector and delegates to callOptionalReturn.
safeTransferFrom encodes selector and delegates to callOptionalReturn.
safeApprove encodes selector and delegates to callOptionalReturn.
callOptionalReturn invokes an arbitrary token via low-level call, enabling reentrancy.
callOptionalReturn requires isContract(token) before calling.
isContract executes inline assembly extcodehash on the account.
SafeMath.add stores the computed sum in local c.
SafeMath.sub stores the computed difference in local c.
mint account parameter indexes into _balances.
mint amount parameter is added to balances and supply via SafeMath.
_transfer sender parameter indexes the debited balance.
_transfer recipient parameter indexes the credited balance.
_transfer amount parameter drives the SafeMath balance arithmetic.
approve spender parameter indexes the _allowances mapping.
approve amount parameter is written as the allowance value.
isContract codehash local holds the extcodehash result.
callOptionalReturn local returndata/success comes from the external low-level call.

normalization_plan.reason: account is a local parameter only meaningful inside the mint function.
amount parameter is consumed directly by the mint arithmetic.
sender parameter is scoped to the _transfer balance update.
recipient parameter is scoped to the _transfer balance update.
amount parameter is consumed by _transfer SafeMath operations.
spender parameter is scoped to the approve allowance write.
amount parameter is scoped to the approve allowance write.
local c is the transient result of the SafeMath addition helper.
codehash local is only used to evaluate the isContract predicate.
returndata/success locals exist only for the low-level external call result.
